description: Self-hosted settings (platform, endpoint, token, repositories) are NOT here -- they are admin-only options and live in apps/renovate/cronjob.yaml as RENOVATE_* env vars.

The kubernetes manager below ships NO default file pattern. Without managerFilePatterns, Renovate runs clean, reports success and finds ZERO images. If a run ever reports a suspiciously low dependency count, check that first.

packageRules.description: Patch and digest bumps land themselves once CI is green. Minor/major always wait for a human -- those are the ones that can move a schema.
Never automerge a minor or major bump, even for a dependency whose patches automerge.
Our own apps are pushed by their own CD pipelines, not bumped here. The tag in this repo is a pointer, not a version to track.
apps/openclaw/kustomization.yaml rewrites this ref to our own registry, so the upstream image is never pulled and bumping it would be a no-op.
Home Assistant ships breaking config changes in minor releases and drives the whole house. Never automerge it; group its bumps so they are reviewed as one.
Immich pins server and machine-learning to the same release; a split bump breaks the pair.
Databases: never automerge, and never take a major without a human reading the upgrade notes.
Base images used only as throwaway job/init containers -- safe to keep current automatically.
